## Scope / canonical decision

Source IDs, D1/D2/ADR, tenant and data classes affected:

## Evidence

- [ ] Format / lint / strict types / unit / build
- [ ] Cross-tenant / object / field / revocation / MFA
- [ ] Contracts / idempotency / audit / provenance / immutable history
- [ ] Migrations / restore / forward-fix / data preservation
- [ ] SAST / SCA / secrets / licenses / SBOM
- [ ] Visual reference / keyboard / themes / locales where relevant
- [ ] No real data, secrets or unapproved external integration

## Rollout and remaining gates

Owner, deployment authorization, rollback/forward-fix, evidence links. No automatic promotion.
